input.quote: Subject to termination pursuant to this Agreement, the Non Exclusive license granted by Licensor to Licensee shall be for an initial period of 36 months, commencing from the acceptance date, (the "Initial Period").
input.rationale: There is no Customer termination-for-convenience right in a 36-month committed term, which is our walk-away position, while Licensor may "immediately terminate" on any breach of any covenant with no materiality or cure period. Redline adds a 30-day convenience right with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees; we will also ask that Licensor's termination right be limited to uncured material breach.

input.quote: The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor.
input.rationale: Renewal is a seven-year extension exercisable unilaterally by Licensor — an automatic multi-year renewal we cannot exit, which is our walk-away position, and there is no cap on renewal pricing. Redline converts this to mutual 12-month renewals with uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%.

input.quote: the parties agree that the validity, interpretation and legal effect of this Agreement shall be governed by the internal laws of the State of New York, U.S.A.
input.rationale: New York law with exclusive jurisdiction of the federal and state courts in New York City matches our preferred position, and there is no arbitration clause. Note only that Article XXIV(d) adds prevailing-party fee shifting, which is acceptable but we may propose deletion as a commercial point.
